ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area (approx. 80-85%) with localized high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal lobe tips (approx. 15-20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are localized to the outer distal margins of both lobes. These regions contain high-frequency dark speckling. The central fluke body is a contiguous low-intensity dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible deep V-shaped central notch with an acute internal angle; depth is approximately 10% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude and jaggedness on the outer third of the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Occasional small, isolated white circular pixel clusters scattered across the dark central fluke, most visible on the right-side lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) are present; notable parallel scratch sets oriented diagonally on the central-left and mid-right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scarring) across the dark surfaces of both lobes; irregular margins on the distal trailing edges suggest minor historical tissue loss.
